title: First Birthday Party Hats Recalled by Creative Expressions Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Foil fringe glued to the bottom edge of the party hats can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 43,100.

title: Gemmy Industries Corp. Recalls Flashing Eyeball Toys Due to Chemical Hazard
summary: The plastic eyeball contains kerosene, which, if broken, presents a chemical hazard to children. Units: About 500.

title: Personalized Infant Long Johns Recalled by Personal Creations Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The metal snaps on the long johns can loosen and detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,500.

title: Thermador® Ceramic Cooktops Recalled by BSH Home Appliances Corp. Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The cooktop can come on by itself when switched off, creating a potential fire hazard if flammable items are left on the cooktop. Units: About 2,000.

title: Cannondale Recalls Bicycles With Carbon Crankset Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's crankset could break, posing a fall hazard to user. Units: About 2,900.

title: General Electric Recalls Gas Ranges Due to Fire Hazard
summary: These ranges have a design flaw that can cause an electrical arc between the wiring and griddle gas supply tube, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: Simplicity Recalls Cribs Due to Fall, Entrapment and Choking Hazards
summary: The assembly instructions provided with the cribs incorrectly instruct consumers how to attach the crib's drop side. If improperly installed, the drop side can disengage from the crib, posing fall and entrapment hazards for the child. Additionally, the metal locking pins on the drop side can pop off

title: Pier 1 Imports Expands Recall of Glassware Pieces
summary: The glassware can crack or break unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 219,000 (This recall was first announced in May 2007).

title: ATVs Recalled by Polaris Industries Inc. Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled ATVs may have a loose fuel valve within the fuel tank, which could cause a fuel leak and pose a fire hazard to riders. Units: About 930 units.

title: Children's Necklaces Recalled by GeoCentral Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The metal clasp on the necklace contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 19,000.

title: Cummins Power Generation Inc. Recalls Stationary Natural Gas and Propane Fueled Generators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The generator's fuel shut-off valve can fail to close, resulting in a gas leak from the unit. This poses a risk of fire and burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 3,300.

title: Far East Imports Recalls Fireworks Due to Eye Injury Hazard
summary: These fireworks devices can travel in an unexpected and dangerous direction, which could pose eye and other injury hazards to bystanders. Units: About 13,600.

title: Gateway Inc. Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: These lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, which could pose a fire hazard to consumers. This is not an internal battery cell defect. Units: About 14,000.

title: Jake's Fireworks Inc. Recalls Fireworks Sold by World Class Distributors Due to Burn and Injury Hazards
summary: The tubes on these fireworks devices could become loose, making the devices unstable during use. If the device tips over during use, it could pose burn and injury hazards to bystanders. Units: About 4,000.

title: Briggs & Stratton Snow Thrower Engines Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: When the engines are primed, excess fuel can overflow into the carburetor and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 480,000.

title: Asko Cylinda Recalls DW95 Series Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in the dishwasher can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 130,000.

title: Children's Jeweled Sandals Sold by Nordstrom Recalled Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The jewel decorations on the shoes can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,800.

title: Choking Hazard Prompts Nordstrom Recall of Children's Jackets
summary: The zipper pull can detach from the jacket's zipper, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,900.

title: Cannondale Announces Recall of Mountain Bicycles; Lefty Forks Can Break Unexpectedly
summary: The forks can break during use, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 6,700.

title: RC2 Corp. Recalls Various Thomas & Friends™ Wooden Railway Toys Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: Surface paints on the recalled products contain lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 1.5 million.

title: Globe Fire Sprinkler Corp. Recalls Dry Fire Sprinklers: Model J Heads Can Fail to Operate During a Fire
summary: The sprinkler heads can deteriorate over time and fail to operate in a fire. Units: About 300,000.

title: Silver Stud Earrings Sold Exclusively at Kmart Recalled by Crimzon Rose Accessories Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled earrings contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 5,300.

title: Fire Hazard with Thermador® Built-In Ovens Leads to Recall by BSH Home Appliances Corp.
summary: The oven can have gaps in the insulation where overheating can occur and, when used in the self-cleaning mode, it can cause nearby cabinets to overheat. This can pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 42,000.

title: Ceramic Heaters Recalled By Lasko; Heaters Could Pose A Fire Hazard
summary: The heater's cord can overheat where it enters the base of the unit, which could pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.2 million.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The flange, which holds the fuel pump in the fuel tank, can fail to stay connected to the tank itself. This can create a fuel leak, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Target Recalls Toy Barbeque Grills Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The circular ash tray attached to the stainless steel legs of the grill could contain sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,300.

title: Bond Manufacturing Co. Issues Recall for Folding Recliner Chairs That Can Collapse and Injure Users
summary: The chairs can collapse or fall backward due to faulty support brackets or weak frames, posing fall and severe laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 68,000.
